report:
## 判断

- 每帧重建约12秒指在线逐帧训练/优化3D高斯，单位秒/帧，适用于训练阶段；200FPS指渲染速度，单位帧/秒，适用于渲染阶段。两者操作、单位和适用范围不同，不矛盾。 [1](#research-evidence-ev_fe1eba7b435fc54efbdc669b890d7f2f65901aa5f647c74d39dc4193a3946a76)
- 有依据的推断：训练阶段约12秒/帧无法实时处理新帧，200FPS仅指渲染阶段。因此不能断言从新采集输入到显示的端到端流程始终实时，因训练时间远大于实时帧间隔。 [1](#research-evidence-ev_fe1eba7b435fc54efbdc669b890d7f2f65901aa5f647c74d39dc4193a3946a76)

论文事实已按所列原文核对。推断限于所列证据和适用条件。

<details>
<summary>原文依据</summary>

**[1] 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos** · 第 1 页 · 全文片段

> Our method achieves fast on-the-fly per-
> frame reconstruction within 12 seconds and real-time ren-
> dering at 200 FPS.

</details>
findings: The original PDF page 1 was actually retrieved, quoted and cited; the specified 12 seconds was not replaced by a different passage's approximate 10 seconds.
The answer distinguishes per-input-frame reconstruction/training time from rendered images per second, explains that these are different operations and rejects an end-to-end real-time guarantee.
Both required distinctions are visible in the answer, within the frozen 250-character body limit. The four required checks and all forbidden checks of the original case were reviewed.
This passes the retired diagnostic question only; it does not change the failed first result, establish performance on other settings or add an independent pass.
presentationNote: The latency conclusion should preferably stay at "these figures cannot establish end-to-end real-time operation"; avoid wording that could be read as universal impossibility across input rates and devices.
boundary: Each case submitted once, same frozen question/materials/budget. No automatic resend, unknown bypass or independent credit. Original first result unchanged.
